name: Delivery zone source configuration
description: Passed to the registered zone source as is. The keys below are the ones the KML source reads; another source may accept others. One city: write the keys flat. Several cities: add a "cities" list, where every entry inherits the keys outside it and may override them.

url.description: Google My Maps viewer link or any URL that returns KML. On a multi-city installation this belongs inside each cities entry.

externalIdSource.description: Where the stable zone key comes from. "name" detaches local settings when a zone is renamed in the map, so choose it deliberately.

extendedDataField.description: Which ExtendedData field holds the identifier

updateDescriptions.description: Lets the source own zone descriptions. Off by default, because operators write delivery terms into that field.

cities.description: One entry per city, each with its own document. Leave this out entirely on a single-city installation. A city listed twice is refused: the second run would mark everything the first imported as missing.

city.description: City id. Zones imported here are scoped to it, and the same external id in another city is a different zone.

externalIdSource.description: Where this city's zone keys come from. Written by the source popup; a Google My Maps export has only names, so a link pasted there gets "name".
